correctness.rationale: Lax dependence-team split into three constancy atoms is equivalent to existence of a selector c in A^3 hitting every team row in at least one matching coordinate; hence failure is total domination of the direct product K3^3 and minimal failure is minimal total domination. For every deleted t of minimal obstruction, private c(t) yields multilinear P_t=prod_i(X_i-c_i(t)) with delta-supported evaluations on T: at most dimension 2^3=8 independent rows. Any <=4 rows can be covered by pigeonhole pair in one coordinate plus remaining two coordinate hyperplanes; explicit five-row even-parity plus (2,2,2) team fails. Independent, separately coded C++ missed-neighborhood union exhaustive enumeration visited sum_(k=1)^8 C(27,k)=3,505,698 candidate subsets, recovered minimal teams by size 5:54, 6:3672, 7:36612, 8:17793 and under all 1296 value/coordinate renamings 1,10,41,24 orbits. Primary C++ compatibility-intersection enumeration and complete 76 representative ORBIT_CLASSES.csv were also examined; exact finite census covers all possible rows due size bound.
residual_risks: Finite arithmetic and group orbit implementation must be correct; two algorithmically different implementations agree, but no machine-independent formal certification. The theorem is fixed to 3 vars x 3 values only.
